terminologyCensus.classification: generic upload, document, drag/drop, and attachment terminology outside the audit evidence and primitive dependency ledgers is unrelated to a higher-level runtime composition

document.primitiveBoundary: File Row owns the reusable 55px identity rows

uploadDrag.primitiveBoundary: distinct higher-level source composition; no runtime implementation

smallDocument.primitiveBoundary: source composition distinct from repository Document Row extension

attachedDocument.primitiveBoundary: nested attachment representation inside Upload-Drag; no attachment lifecycle is inferred

dragAndDropDocument.primitiveBoundary: nested static states inside Upload-Drag; no drag/drop behavior is inferred

sourceClaims.claim: Documents.svg is a 700 by 2269 sheet with four blue dashed composition frames, one 240 by 55 and four 230 by 55 Document specimens, two 467 by 102 dashed upload-drop surfaces, and two raster-backed document-preview placements

Detailed appeals.svg is an 873 by 4163 application-composition sheet with three blue dashed frames representing Employees, Event plaque, and Event material; direct inspection classifies it outside the Upload / Document composition family

all six family names map to Documents.svg; Attached Document and Drag and Drop Document are nested representations within its Upload-Drag frame, while Detailed appeals.svg is an inspected out-of-family roadmap reference
File Row accounts for the source-backed 55px file identity specimens, while Document Row remains a repository extension; neither is an enclosing upload composition
the bounded VERIFIED disposition rests on source integrity, a primitive-boundary ledger, and mutation-sensitive absence evidence rather than an illustrative upload implementation
static drop zones and attachment artwork do not establish file selection, drag events, validation, progress, retry, preview, removal, transport, persistence, or form integration

evidence.source-integrity: pass: exact hashes are locked for Documents.svg and the inspected Detailed appeals.svg reference; all six family variants and their enclosing geometry are traced to Documents.svg
evidence.structural-contract: pass: repository-wide scanning finds zero higher-level runtime or public-export signatures and classifies ten File Row or Document Row dependency surfaces separately; synthetic higher-level surfaces are rejected
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: the higher-level family has no runtime root, controller, event contract, or public API; primitive browser behavior is not inherited
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: no higher-level production semantics, keyboard model, focus order, status announcement, or accessible naming contract exists
evidence.focused-visual: not-applicable: raw source artwork is authoritative but no implemented higher-level composition or material runtime state exists for comparison
evidence.consumer-integration: not-applicable: the Showcase surfaces render only independently audited File Row and Document Row fixtures, not a live higher-level consumer
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: the static exports establish no higher-level responsive reflow, dynamic content, upload lifecycle, empty, progress, success, or error behavior

staticVisual: pass: direct source inspection records the six represented variants, including Attached Document and Drag and Drop Document nested inside Upload-Drag, and the File Row or Document Row boundary without runtime claims
realInteractionVisual: not-applicable: no executable higher-level Upload / Document composition exists on which a browser can create a real interaction state
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: selection, drag/drop, validation, progress, retry, preview, removal, transport, persistence, and form behavior are outside the static source contract

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: not-applicable: no executable higher-level surface exists; manual review covered both raw SVG sheets, all six named source groups, and the primitive-boundary census on 2026-08-28

knownLimitations: VERIFIED describes only the bounded source, primitive-boundary, and repository-absence audit and does not mean a production uploader exists
outlined text and raster-backed application screenshots do not establish literal runtime copy, structured semantics, or reusable screen layout
File Row and Document Row retain their independent Wave 5 contracts and evidence; no primitive status is combined with this family
Chromium interaction and screenshot evidence is intentionally inapplicable until a separately approved executable contract exists
